name: @dshp/widget-kit
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) widget kit: a business-free standard for plugin-contributed widgets — session-header tray icons (badge / reorder / hide) plus drag-resize-minimize-close floating cards, with a frozen descriptor contract, framework-owned loading/error/refresh states and per-size rendering left to the widget author. 小组件规范：会话顶部托盘 + 可拖拽/缩放/最小化/关闭的卡片宿主，内容如何随尺寸变化由组件提供方决定。
author: Yinxe

scripts.test: node --check lib/host.js && node --check lib/client.js && node scripts/check-geometry.mjs && node scripts/check-store.mjs && node scripts/check-spec-drift.mjs && node scripts/check-css-tokens.mjs && node scripts/check-client.mjs && node ../../shared/scripts/check-css-modules.mjs src/client && echo "syntax ok"
